source: Windows Mobile 6.1 Professional ROM (VGA, 192 dpi) via Device Emulator; Yozora #709
note: This ROM is a VGA build: most modules ship only the 192-dpi resource DLL, so many 1x files are flagged "downscaled" (box filter from the 2x art) or use a native 32 px frame. See per-item flags.

status-data-off.notes: Connectivity, not connected (arrows with x), as in ref/today.png.

status-signal-search-1.notes: Antenna + 1 dot; with -2/-3 probably the searching-for-service sequence. No ascending signal-bar icons exist in this ROM dump.

status-data-anim-00.notes: Data arrows sequence 4744-4761 (frames in id order); probably the connecting/transfer animation. Frame 00 = both arrows, no tails.

title-close.notes: Glyph only (white, alpha from mask). Canvas is the whole title-bar cell: at 2x x=433..478, y=0..51 on a 480-wide screen. The green button behind it is drawn (see README/report).

title-ok.notes: Glyph only, same cell as title-close.

sip-keyboard.notes: White keyboard glyph (identical to shellres.192 icon 5081). msim.dll 1x icon 15376 is the older grey 2-bpp keyboard art (different design), so 1x is downscaled.

app-today-lg.notes: No 96-dpi resource in this VGA ROM; 1x uses the native 32x32 frame of the 192-dpi group (the 2x small-icon art), not a resample.

today-phone.notes: Wireless "Phone off" item. shellres icon 13999 is the 64px variant of the same art.

start-flag.notes: WM 6.1 Start flag, drawn at x=4, y=8 of the 50 px title bar (2x). Not the default: only for Settings > Menus > Start (Windows flag), Yukimi's 2026-11-07 opt-in exception to the copyright rule (the default Start mark stays the Melaton emblem). A 2 px separator follows at x=50..51 (2x), y=7..45, title colour at the ends to #84C35A at y=26.

status-mail.notes: New e-mail / unread messages: the white envelope WM 6.1 shows in the title bar (Messaging). Replaces the colour app-messaging icon there.

status-sms.notes: New text message: the phone and envelope WM 6.1 shows in the title bar while text messages are unread (Text Messages = Chat, #763). 6.5's own drawing (its outres.192 32508, anti-aliased) is public/static_images/wm65/status-sms*.png.

status-reminder.notes: Reminder bell: the title-bar glyph for a pending reminder notification.

status-prints.notes: Melaton extension: prints in progress. A picture (frame, sun, two hills) drawn 1-bit in the size and strokes of outres 32507 (32 x 24 frame at y 6..29, 4 px sides); the ROM has no picture or printer title-bar glyph. Source: ~/.cache/wm61/tools/draw-status-melaton.py.

status-director.notes: Melaton extension: the Director. A clapperboard drawn 1-bit in the ROM status glyphs' 2 px strokes on the mail glyph's rows: striped stick between 2 px rails (y 6..13) over a slate with two lines of writing (y 16..29); the ROM has no matching glyph. scripts/generate-wm-director-icon.py (open-N: stick lifted 4 degrees a step).

app-folder-dreamscape.notes: Not ROM art: our own WM 6.1 style icon (docs/design/wm61-icon-style.md). For Dreamscape program folder. Subject: an open yellow manila Windows folder, exactly like the reference Games folder (same folder shape, colour, angle and back panel), with a small square deep navy blue badge leaning in front of it at the lower left (where the playing card is in the reference), the badge showing the white Dreamscape emblem: a thick brush-stroke ring open at the upper right with small square pixels breaking away from the gap.

app-folder-dreamscape-lg.notes: Large (Programs grid) version of app-folder-dreamscape. Not ROM art.

status-bluetooth.notes: Bluetooth, title-bar format (white oval, alpha); 4692 is pixel-identical. Shown while the phone's Bluetooth is on (Android app AndroidDevice).

wrls-all-on.notes: Wireless Manager glyph: All (power), on. Strip order = strings 18304-18307 (All, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Phone).

wrls-all-off.notes: Wireless Manager glyph: All (power), off (with the X). Strip order = strings 18304-18307 (All, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Phone).

wrls-wifi-on.notes: Wireless Manager glyph: Wi-Fi (antenna), on. Strip order = strings 18304-18307 (All, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Phone).

wrls-wifi-off.notes: Wireless Manager glyph: Wi-Fi (antenna), off (with the X). Strip order = strings 18304-18307 (All, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Phone).

wrls-bluetooth-on.notes: Wireless Manager glyph: Bluetooth, on. Strip order = strings 18304-18307 (All, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Phone).

wrls-bluetooth-off.notes: Wireless Manager glyph: Bluetooth, off (with the X). Strip order = strings 18304-18307 (All, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Phone).

wrls-phone-on.notes: Wireless Manager glyph: Phone (handset), on. Strip order = strings 18304-18307 (All, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Phone).

wrls-phone-off.notes: Wireless Manager glyph: Phone (handset), off (with the X). Strip order = strings 18304-18307 (All, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Phone).

wrls-nfc-on.notes: Wireless Manager glyph: NFC (WM 6.1 had none). The NFC N mark (a bold N in a rounded square) in the ROM glyph style, top-left aligned so the off version's X (copied from wrls-wifi-off) has its corner.

1x.source: Melaton drawn (scratch generator, NFC N mark)

wrls-nfc-off.notes: Wireless Manager glyph: NFC (WM 6.1 had none). The NFC N mark (a bold N in a rounded square) in the ROM glyph style, top-left aligned so the off version's X (copied from wrls-wifi-off) has its corner with a 1 px gap.

app-folder-android.notes: Not ROM art: our own WM 6.1 style icon (docs/design/wm61-icon-style.md). For Android programs folder. Subject: an open yellow manila Windows folder, exactly like the reference Games folder (same folder shape, colour, angle and back panel), with a small friendly leaf-green robot head (a half-dome with two short antennae on top and two white dot eyes) leaning in front of it at the lower left, where the playing card is in the reference.

app-folder-android-lg.notes: Large (Programs grid) version of app-folder-android. Not ROM art.

app-program-icons.notes: Not ROM art: our own WM 6.1 style icon (docs/design/wm61-icon-style.md). For Program Icons (choose and make Windows Mobile icons for the phone's programs). Subject: three overlapping glossy rounded program icon cards fanned out like playing cards (a sky blue card with a white star, a leaf green card with a white note, an amber card with a white gear), with an artist's paintbrush with a wet blue tip leaning across the lower right.

app-program-icons-lg.notes: Large (Programs grid) version of app-program-icons. Not ROM art.
